title: show() same-index guard boundary untested: form-errors initial paint could seed a green if the guard is removed
detail: The i!==leaving guard is what stops the initial-paint show() from rederiving the landing step. On form-errors landing on a gating-complete-but-server-invalid step, removing it seeds a green at first paint, breaking the frozen-intent 'form-errors seeds nothing' rule. Only manual browser replay covers this; no automated test reaches the wiring.
recommended_fix: Add a form-bug-hunt stepper:true scenario that submits with a filled-but-invalid field, asserts the error-page start step lacks .stepper-segment-done on arrival, or export a testable show/initial-paint seam for node.
